title: Motion animates only transform and opacity, and honours reduced motion
context: Landing scroll animation already runs on the compositor; the rest of the app had no stated motion rule.
decision: App motion animates transform and opacity only, never layout properties, and every animation has a reduced-motion form that shows the end state without movement. Landing motion values stay scoped to the landing.

alternatives.option: Motion tokens in the global stylesheet
alternatives.reason: Landing-only values would leak into the app.

consequences: Animating a layout property is a review finding.
